## Activity

River Outreach recorded 41 captures during July 2025. Activity was completed as part of routine site operations, with all captures submitted for review. The reported activity provides the basis for monitoring workload, image quality and grading outcomes during the month. The site should continue to record capture activity consistently so that future operational review remains clear and comparable.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 2 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.9. The result should be reviewed alongside local operating conditions and any recurring equipment or camera concerns. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk to support follow-up and resolution.

## Grading

There were 6 referable results during July 2025. The median grading lag was 1 day. Grading performance should continue to be monitored with the site activity and image-quality results, particularly where image issues may affect the review process. Further operational concerns should be recorded through the established service desk route.
